title: Uniform bound on register values
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a register state and $B$ a natural number. If every component of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, then every entry of its length-fifteen register vector is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: every component of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
replaced:
Let a register record fifteen natural-number values, and suppose each of its fifteen
components is at most $B$. Then every entry of the associated length-fifteen vector of
register values is at most $B$.
